rights.title: This app holds repair rules for the EU and EEA only
rights.detail: It makes no claim about what the law in India entitles you to; your seller's warranty and local consumer law still apply. The country comes from this browser's time zone.

rights.title: India: the government's Right to Repair Portal
rights.detail: Run by the Department of Consumer Affairs, it gathers brands' manuals, spare-part prices and warranty information for sectors including mobile phones and tablets and consumer durables. Brands join voluntarily, and it is an information portal, not a legal right to repair.
rights.source: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
